page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number left; headings and paragraphs in the column; no margin notes. Bottom: catchword "Colo-" at right below the last line. Right edge shows show-through from the facing page, not transcribed.

main_text.head: CENSIONIS. CIVIUM-ROMANORUM. QUIRITUM, LUSTRATIONUM.
main_text.p: Quinto anno lustrabantur cives Romani. Quorsum noster allusit. Capt. Prol. v.15.

p.i: Vos qui ope vestra potestis censerier.

main_text.head: CINERUM.
main_text.p: Cinere eluebant vasa, quò allusit Mil. 4.2. v.10.
main_text.head: CLAUDICATIONIS.
main_text.p: Claudi cum fuste incedere solent. Asin. 2.4. v.21.
main_text.head: CLIENTELÆ. PATROCINII. CLIENTUM. PATRONORUM.
main_text.p: Clientes patronis suis in æde sacrâ convivium parabant: quod vocabant Cœnam popularem. Trin. 2.4. v.67. Vide Tit. Convivÿ.
Patronos appellabant, quorū beneficijs utebantur. Mil. 3.3. v.41.

page.notes: Woodcut-style decorative initials C and Q are printed as large letters; the initial "Quinto" and "Cinere", "Claudi", "Clientes" are large initials joined to their words.
